description.en: 50 essential workplace sentences for hotel maintenance technicians working with housekeeping, front desk, and technical colleagues.
description.it: 50 frasi essenziali sul lavoro per tecnici della manutenzione alberghiera che collaborano con housekeeping, reception e colleghi tecnici.

sentences.target_text: Goedemorgen! Zijn er vandaag dringende storingen?

translations.en: Good morning! Are there any urgent malfunctions today?
translations.it: Buongiorno! Ci sono guasti urgenti oggi?

sentences.notes: 'Storingen' = malfunctions/faults. Great way to start the morning briefing.

sentences.target_text: Ik begin eerst op de tweede verdieping.

translations.en: I am starting on the second floor first.
translations.it: Inizio prima al secondo piano.

sentences.target_text: Heb je de lijst met klussen voor vandaag?

translations.en: Do you have the list of jobs for today?
translations.it: Hai la lista dei lavori per oggi?

sentences.target_text: Waar ligt de moersleutel van de werkplaats?

translations.en: Where is the wrench from the workshop?
translations.it: Dov'è la chiave inglese dell'officina?

sentences.target_text: Ik heb de hoofdsleutel bij me.

translations.en: I have the master key with me.
translations.it: Ho il passepartout (chiave maestra) con me.

sentences.notes: 'Hoofdsleutel' or 'loper' is used for master key.

sentences.target_text: Welke kamers zijn nu al vrij?

translations.en: Which rooms are already vacant now?
translations.it: Quali stanze sono già libere adesso?

sentences.notes: Ask housekeeping before entering rooms for repairs.

sentences.target_text: Is kamer tweehonderdvier al uitgecheckt?

translations.en: Has room 204 checked out already?
translations.it: La camera 204 ha già fatto il check-out?

sentences.target_text: Ik ben over tien minuten klaar in deze kamer.

translations.en: I will be finished in this room in ten minutes.
translations.it: Finisco in questa stanza tra dieci minuti.

sentences.notes: Useful so housekeeping knows when they can clean.

sentences.target_text: Kun je kamer driehonderdtien eerst schoonmaken?

translations.en: Can you clean room 310 first?
translations.it: Puoi pulire prima la camera 310?

sentences.target_text: Let op, de vloer in de badkamer is nog nat.

translations.en: Watch out, the floor in the bathroom is still wet.
translations.it: Attenzione, il pavimento del bagno è ancora bagnato.

sentences.target_text: Ik heb wat stof gemaakt, sorry! Ik zuig het even op.

translations.en: I made some dust, sorry! I'll vacuum it up quickly.
translations.it: Ho fatto un po' di polvere, scusa! Passo subito l'aspirapolvere.

sentences.target_text: De lamp bij het bed is kapot, ik heb hem vervangen.

translations.en: The lamp by the bed is broken, I replaced it.
translations.it: La lampada vicino al letto è rotta, l'ho sostituita.

sentences.target_text: De afstandsbediening heeft nieuwe batterijen nodig.

translations.en: The remote control needs new batteries.
translations.it: Il telecomando ha bisogno di batterie nuove.

sentences.target_text: De kluis in de kast zit op slot en gaat niet open.

translations.en: The safe in the closet is locked and won't open.
translations.it: La cassaforte nell'armadio è bloccata e non si apre.

sentences.target_text: Mag ik even je stofzuiger lenen?

translations.en: May I borrow your vacuum cleaner for a moment?
translations.it: Posso prendere in prestito il tuo aspirapolvere un attimo?

sentences.target_text: De verwarming in kamer honderdtwaalf doet het niet.

translations.en: The heating in room 112 is not working.
translations.it: Il riscaldamento nella camera 112 non funziona.

sentences.notes: 'Doet het niet' = doesn't work (very natural Dutch).

sentences.target_text: De airco lekt water op het tapijt.

translations.en: The air conditioner is leaking water onto the carpet.
translations.it: L'aria condizionata perde acqua sulla moquette.

sentences.target_text: De afvoer van de douche zit helemaal verstopt.

translations.en: The shower drain is completely clogged.
translations.it: Lo scarico della doccia è completamente intasato.

sentences.target_text: De kraan in de wastafel blijft druppelen.

translations.en: The faucet in the sink keeps dripping.
translations.it: Il rubinetto del lavandino continua a gocciolare.

sentences.target_text: Ik moet het water op deze verdieping even afsluiten.

translations.en: I have to shut off the water on this floor for a moment.
translations.it: Devo chiudere l'acqua su questo piano per un momento.

sentences.target_text: De stop is doorgeslagen in de meterkast.

translations.en: The fuse has blown in the breaker box.
translations.it: È saltato il salvavita/fusibile nel quadro elettrico.

sentences.target_text: Er is geen warm water op de vierde verdieping.

translations.en: There is no hot water on the fourth floor.
translations.it: Non c'è acqua calda al quarto piano.

sentences.target_text: Ik moet een nieuw onderdeel bestellen voor de ketel.

translations.en: I need to order a new part for the boiler.
translations.it: Devo ordinare un pezzo nuovo per la caldaia.

sentences.target_text: Het kaartslot van de deur reageert niet.

translations.en: The keycard lock on the door is not responding.
translations.it: La serratura a scheda della porta non risponde.

sentences.target_text: De deur sluit niet goed, ik ga het scharnier bijstellen.

translations.en: The door doesn't close properly, I will adjust the hinge.
translations.it: La porta non si chiude bene, vado a regolare la cerniera.

sentences.target_text: Het raam kan niet meer dicht.

translations.en: The window won't close anymore.
translations.it: La finestra non si chiude più.

sentences.target_text: Ik ga de siliconenkit in de douche vernieuwen.

translations.en: I am going to replace the silicone sealant in the shower.
translations.it: Vado a rifare il silicone nella doccia.

sentences.target_text: De douche mag pas morgen weer gebruikt worden.

translations.en: The shower can only be used again tomorrow.
translations.it: La doccia potrà essere usata di nuovo solo domani.

sentences.target_text: De lift staat stil tussen twee verdiepingen.

translations.en: The elevator is stuck between two floors.
translations.it: L'ascensore è bloccato tra due piani.

sentences.target_text: We moeten de monteur van het liftbedrijf bellen.

translations.en: We need to call the technician from the elevator company.
translations.it: Dobbiamo chiamare il tecnico della ditta degli ascensori.

sentences.target_text: Het brandalarm in de gang geeft een foutmelding.

translations.en: The fire alarm in the hallway is showing an error message.
translations.it: L'allarme antincendio nel corridoio dà un messaggio di errore.

sentences.target_text: Kun je deze ladder even voor me vasthouden?

translations.en: Can you hold this ladder for me for a moment?
translations.it: Puoi tenermi ferma questa scala per un attimo?

sentences.target_text: De wc blijft doorlopen, ik vervang de vlotter.

translations.en: The toilet keeps running, I am replacing the float valve.
translations.it: Il water continua a scorrere, sostituisco il galleggiante.

sentences.target_text: Kamer honderdvijf is weer helemaal in orde.

translations.en: Room 105 is completely fine again.
translations.it: La camera 105 è di nuovo tutto a posto.

sentences.target_text: Deze kamer kan vandaag niet verhuurd worden.

translations.en: This room cannot be rented out today.
translations.it: Questa camera non può essere affittata oggi.

sentences.notes: Crucial phrase for the front desk ('receptie').

sentences.target_text: De gast moet helaas naar een andere kamer verhuizen.

translations.en: Unfortunately, the guest has to move to another room.
translations.it: Purtroppo l'ospite deve spostarsi in un'altra stanza.

sentences.target_text: Pardon, technische dienst! Mag ik even binnenkomen?

translations.en: Excuse me, maintenance! May I come in for a moment?
translations.it: Permesso, servizio tecnico! Posso entrare un attimo?

sentences.target_text: Ik kom even kijken naar de televisie.

translations.en: I'm here to take a quick look at the television.
translations.it: Vengo a dare un'occhiata alla televisione.

sentences.notes: 'Even kijken naar' = take a quick look at.

sentences.target_text: Het is opgelost! Alles werkt weer normaal.

translations.en: It is solved! Everything works normally again.
translations.it: È risolto! Tutto funziona di nuovo normalmente.

sentences.target_text: Zal ik de receptie bellen om het door te geven?

translations.en: Shall I call the front desk to let them know?
translations.it: Chiamo io la reception per avvisarli?

sentences.target_text: Ik ga even koffie halen, wil jij ook een kopje?

translations.en: I'm going to grab some coffee, do you want a cup too?
translations.it: Vado a prendere un caffè, ne vuoi una tazza anche tu?

sentences.target_text: Hoe was je weekend? Heb je iets leuks gedaan?

translations.en: How was your weekend? Did you do anything fun?
translations.it: Com'è andato il weekend? Hai fatto qualcosa di bello?

sentences.target_text: Wat een regen vandaag op de fiets!

translations.en: What a lot of rain on the bike today!
translations.it: Quanta pioggia oggi in bici!

sentences.notes: Complaining about rain on the commute is peak Dutch small talk.

sentences.target_text: Ga je nu lunchen? Eet smakelijk!

translations.en: Are you going to have lunch now? Enjoy your meal!
translations.it: Vai a pranzare adesso? Buon appetito!

sentences.notes: 'Eet smakelijk' = Buon appetito / Enjoy your meal.

sentences.target_text: Het is vandaag erg druk in het hotel.

translations.en: It is very busy in the hotel today.
translations.it: C'è molto movimento in hotel oggi.

sentences.target_text: Kun je dat iets langzamer herhalen? Ik leer Nederlands.

translations.en: Can you repeat that a bit slower? I am learning Dutch.
translations.it: Puoi ripeterlo un po' più lentamente? Sto imparando l'olandese.

sentences.notes: Keeps colleagues speaking Dutch to you instead of switching to English.

sentences.target_text: Hoe noem je dit gereedschap in het Nederlands?

translations.en: What do you call this tool in Dutch?
translations.it: Come si chiama questo attrezzo in olandese?

sentences.target_text: Alle urgente klussen van vandaag zijn klaar.

translations.en: All urgent jobs for today are finished.
translations.it: Tutti i lavori urgenti di oggi sono finiti.

sentences.target_text: Ik heb alles opgeschreven in het logboek.

translations.en: I wrote everything down in the logbook.
translations.it: Ho scritto tutto nel registro.

sentences.target_text: Ik ga naar huis, fijne avond en tot morgen!

translations.en: I'm heading home, have a nice evening and see you tomorrow!
translations.it: Vado a casa, buona serata e a domani!
